### SIGA Reports Financial Results for Three and Nine Months Ended September 30, 2026


November 9, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s204.q4cdn.com/957130458/files/doc_news/SIGA-Reports-Financial-Results-for-Three-and-Nine-Months-Ended-September-30-2026-2026.pdf)


- Awarded $15 Million Procurement Contract from Canadian Department of National Defence for Oral TPOXX in October


- Corporate Update Conference Call Today at 4:30 PM ET


NEW YORK, Nov. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- SIGA Technologies, Inc. (SIGA) (Nasdaq: SIGA), a commercial-stage pharmaceutical company, today reported financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026.


“While we continue to work with the U.S. Government toward a new TPOXX procurement contract, our international business remains an important part of our strategy,” stated Diem Nguyen, Chief Executive Officer. “We recently announced a $15 million contract with the Canadian Department of National Defence, a longstanding customer, and are actively pursuing opportunities with other international governments to further diversify our customer base over time.”

**Year-to-Date Business and Operational Activity**


- In October, the Canadian Department of National Defence (CDND) awarded a contract to SIGA for the procurement of oral TPOXX. The contract provides for the purchase of up to approximately $15 million of oral TPOXX by March 31, 2031, of which approximately $9 million represents firm commitments over the first three years of the contract and approximately $6 million is subject to option exercise by the CDND.


- For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, the Company delivered approximately $13 million of oral TPOXX to two international customers.
- For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, the Company delivered approximately $26 million of IV TPOXX to the U.S. Strategic National Stockpile (SNS) under the 19C contract, fulfilling the final procurement order under that contract.


**Year-to-Date Capital Management Activity** On March 26, 2026, a special cash dividend of $0.60 per share was declared, and was paid on April 23, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on April 7, 2026.


**Retirement of Chief Scientific Officer** Dennis Hruby, Ph.D., Executive Vice President and Chief Scientific Officer, will retire effective today, concluding more than 30 years with the Company. Following his retirement, Dr. Hruby will continue to support the Company in an advisory capacity.

**ABOUT SIGA** SIGA is a commercial-stage pharmaceutical company and leader in global health focused on the development of innovative medicines to treat and prevent infectious diseases. With a primary focus on smallpox, we are dedicated to protecting humanity against the world’s most severe infectious diseases, including those that occur naturally, accidentally, or intentionally. Through partnerships with governments and public health agencies, we work to build a healthier and safer world by providing essential countermeasures against these global health threats. For more information about SIGA, visit[www.siga.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=k7Tw2mKO0YpCL5kbgNZ0uiK7q8foOj3h6snutt_hYMgl0jf8Lgz6JH6-6fCyQFxZDjOKuzDTpTW-wUdqrFNNig==) .
